description: Chordino (Mauch and Dixon's NNLS Chroma Vamp plugin), the build bundled by chord-extractor 0.1.3, run through the vamp host: simple chord labels from a least-squares chroma and an HMM. Not learned from data, so a second opinion of another kind beside chords-jiang. Decodes the content again at 44,100 Hz mono with librosa. Runs under the operator's chordino-python. CPU, a single-threaded plugin with a fixed thread cap on numeric libraries.

chords.description: Chordino's labels (its own spelling, N for no chord); each span ends where the next starts, the last at the decoded length
